name: Pill bottle
description: An amber pharmacy bottle with a white child-proof cap.
notes: The tablets and capsules found loose in a cabinet come in it. plastic-amber draws the bottle; it stays see-through in the game. Its label is repainted in its contents' label finish.

name: Glass vial
notes: Holds a few grams of powder or crystal. Its label band is repainted in its contents' label finish.

name: Blister card
description: A foil-backed card of ten clear bubbles.
notes: A pressed-out bubble does not close again, so nothing goes back in once it is spawned. Its printed band is repainted in its contents' label finish.

name: Small tin
description: A round steel tin with a push-on lid.
notes: Its lid label is repainted in its contents' label finish.

name: Paper sack
description: A small kraft paper sack with its top rolled down.
notes: Dry mixes come in it. Its printed band is repainted in its contents' label finish.

name: Zip bag
description: A small clear zip bag with a white panel to write on.
notes: Its write-on panel is repainted in its contents' label finish. Residential stands in for street loot, for which no usage tag exists.
